findings.source_quote: After he was several inches off, one of his friends tried to point it out but he pretended to ignore him. ... Finally, after he was more than a foot off, he stopped.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the original distance phrasing or provide both imperial and metric values. For example: "Efter att han hade kommit flera inches (några tum) utanför... Slutligen, efter att han var mer än en foot (mer än en fot / cirka 30 cm) fel, stannade han." Or in Swedish fully: "Efter att han kommit flera tum utanför... Slutligen, efter att han var mer än en fot fel (cirka 30 cm), stannade han." This keeps the original numeric emphasis while optionally adding metric clarification.
